class.name: YAMLSecurity
class.brief_description: Controls security policies for resource loading during YAML parsing.
class.description:
[YAMLSecurity] manages restrictions on which resources can be loaded from YAML files using the [code]!Resource[/code] tag. It helps guard against unsafe loading of untrusted content by allowing control over allowed resource paths and types. Loading resources is limited to [code]res://[/code] and [code]user://[/code] root paths for security reasons. [b]Basic Security Example:[/b] [codeblock lang=gdscript] var security = YAML.create_security()
# Only allow textures from the game's asset folder security.allow_path("res://assets/textures", ["Texture2D"])
# Block packed scenes for safety security.block_type("PackedScene")
# Parse YAML with custom security settings var yaml_text = """ player: name: Hero sprite: !Resource 'res://assets/textures/player.png' """
var result = YAML.parse(yaml_text, security) if result.has_error(): push_error("Security error: " + result.get_error_message()) else: var data = result.get_data() print("Player sprite loaded: " + str(data.player.sprite is Texture2D)) [/codeblock]

method.name: allow_path
method.description:
Allows loading resources from paths matching [param path_prefix]. Use wildcards [code]*[/code] (single segment) and [code]**[/code] (any number of segments) for pattern matching. If [param type_names] is provided, only resources of those types will be allowed from this path. [codeblock lang=gdscript] var security = YAML.create_security()
# Allow only textures from the mod folder security.allow_path("user://mods", ["Texture2D", "CompressedTexture2D"])
# Parse mod configuration with custom security var mod_yaml = """ mod_info: name: Better Weapons version: 1.2 textures: sword: !Resource 'user://mods/better_weapons/sword.png' axe: !Resource 'user://mods/better_weapons/axe.png' """
var result = YAML.parse(mod_yaml, security) [/codeblock]

method.name: block_type
method.description:
Blocks a resource type globally. Any resources of this type will be rejected during YAML parsing. [codeblock lang=gdscript] var security = YAML.create_security()
# Allow all resources from the game's resource folder security.allow_path("res://**")
# But block scripts and scenes for security security.block_type("Script") security.block_type("GDExtension") security.block_type("PackedScene")
# Any YAML with script or scene references will fail to parse var result = YAML.parse(user_yaml, security) [/codeblock]

method.name: clear_path_restrictions
method.description:
Removes all allowed path rules. No path-based restrictions will be enforced until [method allow_path] is used again. [codeblock lang=gdscript] var security = YAML.create_security()
# Initially limit to specific assets security.allow_path("res://assets/safe_resources")
# Later, remove all path restrictions security.clear_path_restrictions()
# Now all paths are allowed (only type restrictions remain) [/codeblock]

method.name: clear_type_restrictions
method.description:
Removes all blocked resource types, including default blocks on [code]Script[/code] and [code]GDExtension[/code]. [codeblock lang=gdscript] var security = YAML.create_security()
# Remove all type restrictions (including defaults) security.clear_type_restrictions()
# Now even scripts can be loaded (if their paths are allowed) # This is potentially dangerous with untrusted content [/codeblock]

method.name: reset
method.description:
Resets all rules to default values. Clears any custom path rules and blocks [code]Script[/code] and [code]GDExtension[/code] types. [codeblock lang=gdscript] var security = YAML.create_security()
# Custom security config for development security.clear_type_restrictions() security.allow_path("res://**")
# Later, reset to default secure settings for production security.reset()
# Now back to defaults: # - No paths are allowed # - Script and GDExtension types are blocked [/codeblock]
